anonymousBanner.textRest: — but it only exists on this device. Give your e-mail to find it anywhere and order it.

confirmSwitch.title: Switch to automatic mode?
confirmSwitch.body: Bookipix will propose a new layout for your book based on your content. Pages you've already built by hand stay untouched — only the pages still on automatic will be reorganized.

photos.title: Your photos
photos.text: Click "Photos" at the top to open your library, add photos and text there.

dragDrop.title: Drag and drop
dragDrop.text: Drag a memory into a slot on the page — or click it, then click the slot.

layout.title: Layout
layout.text: Click "Layout" (or the icon on the page) to choose the layout for the current page, right next to the book.

navigate.title: Navigate pages
navigate.text: The ‹ › arrows under the book turn pages one at a time. To go straight to a page, the cover, or the back cover, open "Pages".

auto.title: Automatic mode
auto.text: Or let Bookipix compose the whole book ("Compose automatically", at the top), then adjust any pages you like by hand.

classique.label: Classic
classique.description: The usual rhythm, balanced between photos and text.

aere.label: Airy
aere.description: Each photo breathes alone — more pages, less density.

compact.label: Compact
compact.description: Fit as many memories as possible into the chosen page count.

chapitre.label: Chapters
chapitre.description: Title pages punctuate the book, magazine feel.

collage.label: Collage
collage.description: Very photo-heavy, dense grids, almost no text alone.

layoutPanel.title: Layout
layoutPanel.question: What would you like to put on this page?

generateModal.title: Generate automatically
generateModal.intro: Choose a mood: Bookipix composes the whole book at once from your memories, each photo and each piece of text used only once. You can then adjust any page by hand, or regenerate with a different mood.
generateModal.manualKept_one: Your {{count}} page composed by hand is kept as is: generation only fills the remaining pages, and never replaces a photo or memory you've already placed there.
generateModal.manualKept_other: Your {{count}} pages composed by hand are kept as is: generation only fills the remaining pages, and never replaces a photo or memory you've already placed there.
generateModal.replaceWarning: Pages already composed automatically will be replaced by the new proposal. Your photos and memories, on the other hand, are never deleted.

overflow.middle: while your book has {{current}}. Bookipix never leaves a photo out: the book will grow to {{next}} pages
overflow.suffix: . To keep {{current}} pages, close this window and remove some photos in "My memories".

remaining.main_one: Your content fills about {{estimated}} page{{estimatedPlural}} out of the {{min}} in your book: the last page will stay blank.
remaining.main_other: Your content fills about {{estimated}} page{{estimatedPlural}} out of the {{min}} in your book: the last {{count}} pages will stay blank.
remaining.note: Bookipix never repeats a photo or memory to fill the space — you can compose them by hand, or add content in "My memories".

generateModal.willGrowTo: The book will grow to {{pages}} pages

photoAdjustModal.title: Adjust framing
photoAdjustModal.hintContain: The whole photo fits in the frame. Zoom in to fill it more.
photoAdjustModal.hintCover: Drag the photo to reposition it, zoom in if needed.
photoAdjustModal.modeDifferenceHint: Fill the frame: the photo covers the whole slot, even if its edges get cropped. Whole photo: the entire photo stays visible, with a margin if its shape doesn't exactly match the slot.
photoAdjustModal.replacePhotoTitle: Choose a different photo for this slot
photoAdjustModal.ratioGapText: This photo has a very different shape from its frame: part of it is cropped. You can also choose "Whole photo" above to crop nothing.
photoAdjustModal.noSuggestion: No layout in the catalog fits this photo's shape better — cropping remains the best option here.
photoAdjustModal.gutterZoneHint: Safety zone at the binding fold: avoid placing a face or important subject here — drag or zoom the photo to move it out of this zone.

errors.noPageCount: Choose the number of pages for the book (Configuration tab) before opening the editor.
errors.saveFailed: Save failed. Check the content placed.
errors.spreadSiblingFailed: The second page of the spread could not be saved.
errors.photoUploadFailed: The photo could not be imported.
errors.textUpdateFailed: The text change could not be saved.
errors.textCreateFailed: The text could not be created.
errors.moveFailed: The page could not be moved.

undo.restoreLayout: go back to "{{layout}}" with its content

upload.someFailed_one: {{count}} photo out of {{total}} could not be added ({{names}}{{ellipsis}}).
upload.someFailed_other: {{count}} photos out of {{total}} could not be added ({{names}}{{ellipsis}}).
upload.othersOk: The others were saved successfully — you can retry just these ones.

deleteAll.confirmBody: They'll also be removed from the pages where you placed them. This action is irreversible.

removePages.confirmLocked: Pages {{numbers}} contain content or are locked. Delete them permanently?
removePages.confirmContent: Pages {{numbers}} contain content. Delete them permanently?

testBanner.title: Test mode
testBanner.body: editable despite payment, which wouldn't be possible in production.

lockedBanner.title: Book locked
lockedBanner.body: an order has already been paid for this book: it can no longer be edited. Any changes you make will not be saved.

header.inviteTitleManage: See the link, invite, and track contributions
header.inviteTitleNew: Invite your loved ones to add their photos and words
header.composeAutoTitle: Bookipix proposes a new layout for your book — you'll always be able to adjust each page by hand afterward

pagesDrawer.title: All pages
pagesDrawer.hint: Drag a thumbnail to move the page — or set its position with the icon at the corner of the page.

bookView.previewTitle: Preview — print proportions and dimensions respected

coverPanel.autoColorTitle: Let Bookipix choose based on style and format
coverPanel.coverColorHint: Applies to the front, spine, and back cover — a book has only one material.
coverPanel.albumStyleHintFilet: A thin gold hairline separates photos on the same page.
coverPanel.albumStyleHintEncadre: Each photo is outlined with a hairline, on a cream background.
coverPanel.albumStyleHintNu: Photos touch each other, with no separation.
coverPanel.subtitlePlaceholder: E.g. Memories from those who love her

slotHints.text: Drag a memory here, or click to write
slotHints.title: Drag a title here, or click to write

pageOverlay.changePhotoTitle: Choose a different photo for this slot

sidebar.emptyFilterAvailable: Everything is already placed in the book.

textEditor.styleTitle: Text style: automatically picks the font, size, and weight
textEditor.saveTitle: Save (or just click outside the frame)
textEditor.atSmallestSize: The text is already at the smallest printable size: anything more won't fit on the page.
textEditor.doesNotFit: This text no longer fits in its slot.
textEditor.shortenOrChangeLayout: Shorten it, or choose a more generous layout.
textEditor.nearLimit: You're approaching the bottom of the slot ({{percent}}% used).
textEditor.reducedAuto: Text automatically shrunk to fit the slot.
textEditor.magnifiedInfo: Shown larger for writing. Actual print size: {{size}} pt.

pageFilmstrip.removeTitleEnabled: Remove the last 2 pages of the book
pageFilmstrip.addTitle: Add 2 blank pages at the end of the book

finishModal.titleReady: Your book is ready to preview
finishModal.qualityTip: Often, switching the photo to "Whole photo" or choosing a layout better suited to its shape is enough — click a page to try it directly.
finishModal.spreadWarning_one: {{count}} two-page spread photo needs your attention
finishModal.spreadWarning_other: {{count}} two-page spread photos need your attention
finishModal.spreadTip: If a face or an important subject is near the middle of the photo, it risks being cut at printing, at the fold between the two pages. Click a page to move or zoom the photo away from the fold.

pageActions.moveLabel: Move this page in the book

pageActions.moveForward: Move this page one step toward the end
pageActions.moveHint: Other pages shift accordingly. You can also drag the thumbnail in the strip below.
pageActions.movePending: New position chosen: page {{position}}. Confirm to apply.
pageActions.clearHint: Memories stay in your library, only the page is cleared.

duplicatePhotosModal.titleSingular: This photo is already in your book
duplicatePhotosModal.introMiddle: the same name and size as
